directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: slate wordtime core, copied byte for byte

preserve: The source media and output path are the first two positional arguments; the legacy optional start and end window remain usable.
The selected window is cut by ffmpeg to mono 16 kHz audio, with the old -ss and -to argument order and formatting.
The existing Whisper provider receives the requested public model name, English language, and word_timestamps=true.
Returned word bounds are rounded to hundredths and shifted by the source window start.
The written JSON keeps {source, timing: word, words: [{text, start, end}]}; stdout reports the count and destination.
allowed_deltas: Import the package's existing whisper_here provider by its sibling module, not through a private checkout path.
Accept one JSON request on stdin with source, out, optional from, to and model fields, while retaining the old positional command.
Make model selection explicit and default to the public mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo identifier.
banned_substitutions: A second Whisper provider chooser beside whisper_here.
Uniform segment estimates in place of the requested provider word timestamps.
Changing the old media window or source-time offset behavior.
